teleporter/30485.htm.text: Gatekeeper Capella: Greetings. I admire you for surviving this far. If you continue on, you must be even more careful because there are monsters out there that are more terrible than what you could imagine. If you are not sure that you are ready, go prepare yourself thoroughly and then return.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
